lines.en: My footprints sink deep into the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，尾巴扫过草。
lines.en: I walk, my tail sweeping the grass.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上划出三道。
lines.en: My claws score three lines in the earth.

lines.zh: 我低着头，鼻子一直在动。
lines.en: My head is low, nostrils working.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方树都弯了。
lines.en: The trees bend where I pass.
I drag my bulk along.
My stride covers a lot of ground.
I stop and sniff the air.
I turn slowly, my tail cutting the air.

lines.zh: 我踩着倒下的树干走过去。
lines.en: I walk over a fallen trunk.
My toes grip the ground.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落地，泥溅到树上。
lines.en: My foot lands and mud splashes the trees.
The muscle at my neck shifts.
I flatten a patch of ferns.
I walk past the puddle.
My foot sinks into soft earth.

lines.zh: 我的背脊高过这片灌木。
lines.en: My back stands above this brush.
I look down at my own claws.
I pant in the shade.
There is an old wound on my jaw.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴从蕨丛里抽出来。
lines.en: I draw my tail out of the ferns.

lines.zh: 我用鼻孔喷出一团白气。
lines.en: I blow a cloud of white breath from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上轻轻拍。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground.
I crouch and lower my body.
I look at the river valley beyond.

lines.zh: 我的喉间滚出一声低响。
lines.en: A low sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚搁在石头上。
lines.en: I rest one foot on a stone.
The wind cools my nape.

lines.zh: 我把舌头在嘴里转了转。
lines.en: I run my tongue around my mouth.
I stare at a bird in the tree.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息吹动了你的头发。
lines.en: My breath stirs your hair.

lines.zh: 我低头，把你整个装进眼里。
lines.en: I look down and take all of you in.
You smell of raw meat.
You're a head shorter than my leg.

lines.zh: 你的气味让我把嘴张开。
lines.en: Your scent makes my jaws part.
I look down and roll an eye.
You're at my feet like a shadow.
You've gone behind the tree.
I slowly turn my body.
Your shoulders are trembling.

lines.zh: 我给你一次转身的机会。
lines.en: I give you one chance to turn away.
I breathe above your head.

lines.zh: 你的骨架看起来很容易断。
lines.en: Your frame looks easy to break.
I stamp my foot beside you.

lines.zh: 你走的时候，我一直看着你。
lines.en: I keep watching as you walk away.

lines.zh: 你把头低下去，我就看不见你了。
lines.en: You lower your head and I lose sight of you.
My hind legs sink and I give ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，往后退了半步。
lines.en: I lift a foot and give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛眯起来，盯着你。
lines.en: My eyes narrow on you.
I shake my head and blood flecks the ferns.
One of my legs buckles.
I press my chest to the ground.
I turn my head and wheeze like a bellows.

lines.zh: 疼得我把尾巴夹到腹下。
lines.en: Pain draws my tail under my belly.
I retreat slowly to the trees.

lines.zh: 我的黄眼一直没离开你。
lines.en: My yellow eye never leaves you.
I want raw meat, not this.
Is what you hold for me?
I wait for you to drop the meat.
I can smell it; very fresh.
Did you bring more?

lines.zh: 我闻着肉味，喉咙里发响。
lines.en: The smell of meat rumbles in my throat.
I grew up on this.
Don't pull your hand back; I'll bite it.
Stand aside.
I come close, nostrils flaring.
You run headlong into my thigh.

lines.zh: 我只是把身子侧了一下。
lines.en: I merely turn my side.
I step back and the ground gives.
My tail sweeps you aside.
Don't press close; I might step on you.
I lower my head to find you.

lines.zh: 两个身子撞进林子里闷响。
lines.en: Two bodies thud into the trees.
I nearly step on you lifting my foot.
I settle my weight onto my hind legs.
Get over by the tree.

lines.zh: 我这片林子只有我一只。
lines.en: I am the only one in this forest.
You aren't even one of my legs.
I turn away and don't look at it.
I turn my long jaw to the trees.

lines.zh: 我还有很多地方没去过。
lines.en: There are places I haven't been.
Don't touch my neck.
I lay down slowly.
Sit in my shadow.
My kind lives a long time.
I close my eyes, ears still up.

lines.zh: 我低下头，用鼻尖拨了拨。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it with my snout.
This isn't a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把东西翻了个面。
lines.en: I flip it over with my snout.
I fling it into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我咬着它一路拖过泥地。
lines.en: I drag it through the mud.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把它推到一边。
lines.en: I push it aside with my tongue.

lines.zh: 我把它踩进泥里，听它响。
lines.en: I press it into the mud and hear it crack.
I stamp it into the wet earth.
I take whatever is dropped.
I carry it two steps and drop it.
Under these trees is mine.
I stop short, nostrils flaring.
This time you're the one testing me.

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在我的泥里。
lines.en: Your prints are in my mud.
I lean forward, my tail stiffening.
You've walked into my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音沉下去。
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops low.
I can see your legs shaking.
At three I charge.
There is a rock face behind you.
One step reaches you.
I take the first step and the ground groans.
I dig my toes into the soil.
I lower my neck.
I follow you, footsteps heavy.

lines.zh: 你往哪边跑，我都看得见。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I see it.
I herd you toward the rock face.
Do you hear the tree falling?
I knock a bush aside.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，慢慢逼近你。
lines.en: I lower my body and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我一层层剥开草，跟着你。
lines.en: I part the grass layer by layer, following.
You are against the rock.
One block closer through the ferns.
I push my head beneath the canopy.
I lower my head; my jaw opens.
I keep low, toes gripping soil.
You've got behind a tree.
That tree won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息喷在你头顶上。
lines.en: My breath falls on the top of your head.
I hit you side-on and your ribs thud.
I whip my head and you fly.
I swipe you with a claw.

lines.zh: 我的重量全压在你肩上。
lines.en: All my weight bears down on your shoulder.
I pin you underfoot.
You block with your staff; your hands shake.
I ram you solidly.
You brought this on yourself.
I step back half a pace, panting.
I give up the chase.
I whip you with my tail.
My claws pin your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你的护甲上。
lines.en: That bite landed on your armour.
I toss you up.
I trample a clump of ferns.
I raise my head and hit the branch.
I break the branch in my way.
My prints stay in the mud.
I raise my head and sniff the treetops.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸直，看了看这片林地。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and scan the woodland.
I walked a long way to get here.
I hear water and turn toward it.
I push my forebody up out of the mud.
I shake my body.
I begin patrolling this ground.
Someone just walked past.
I knock a clump of trees down.
My claws sink half a foot.
A deep line of prints follows me.
I shake the leaves off.
I look up at the trees here.
The wind brings the forest's smell.
I shake the leaves off my back.
I try one roar.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我往前窜。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I lunge forward.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的腿扭了一下。
lines.en: I fell and twisted a leg.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water covers my head and I kick upward.
The blast tips me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我肩侧的鳞。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder scales.

lines.zh: 那道光抽走了我腿上的力。
lines.en: That light drains the strength from my legs.
I have been hungry for days.
Lightning hits my back and I lurch.
No ground, and I keep falling.
